basic_details.post_name: Dy. General Manager/Electrical, Assistant Manager/Electrical, Engineering Associate-I/Electrical
basic_details.short_information: The National Capital Region Transport Corporation (NCRTC), a joint venture of the Government of India and the participating state governments of Delhi, Haryana, Rajasthan, and Uttar Pradesh, has released Vacancy Notice No. NCRTC/CO/HR/Rectt./28/2026 dated 23 July 2026. NCRTC, functioning under the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, is inviting applications from eligible candidates for the recruitment of Electrical Engineers on a re-employment basis for its Regional Rapid Transit System (RRTS), popularly known as the Namo Bharat corridors.

how_to_apply: Visit the official NCRTC website: www.ncrtc.in
Go to the 'Career' section and select the relevant post as per eligibility.
Register using a valid e-mail ID and mobile number, then fill in the online application form carefully.
Upload the required scanned documents, photograph, and signature as specified.
Preview the application before final submission, as the form cannot be edited once submitted.
After submission, download the system-generated Application Form bearing a Unique Registration Number, take a printout, and attach it with self-attested copies of the supporting documents.
Send the printed application with documents by hand or post, so as to reach on or before 24/08/2026, to the address below.
Career Cell, HR Department, GatiShakti Bhawan, National Capital Region Transport Corporation, INA Colony, New Delhi - 110023
The envelope containing the printout of the application and supporting documents should be superscribed as:
"APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF DY. GENERAL MANAGER/ELECTRICAL - 28/2026/01 ON RE-EMPLOYMENT BASIS", or
"APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ASSISTANT MANAGER/ELECTRICAL - 28/2026/02 ON RE-EMPLOYMENT BASIS", or
"APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ENGINEERING ASSOCIATE-I/ELECTRICAL - 28/2026/03 ON RE-EMPLOYMENT BASIS"
important_instructions: Candidates must fulfil all eligibility criteria before applying; NCRTC will verify eligibility against original documents at the time of interview. If a candidate is found ineligible during document verification, they will not proceed to the next stage, and their candidature will be rejected. Admission to all stages of the selection process is purely provisional, subject to meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria. Candidates should enter their name exactly as it appears on their SSC/Matriculation Certificate. Requests for change of mailing address, e-mail ID, category, or post as declared in the online application will not be entertained. All correspondence with candidates will be done through e-mail only; candidates should keep their registered e-mail ID active for at least one year and check spam/junk folders regularly. Teaching or freelancing experience will not be considered as qualifying experience. Any revision, clarification, addendum, or corrigendum to the notice will be published only on the 'Career' section of www.ncrtc.in; no separate press notification will be issued. Persons previously dismissed, removed, or compulsorily retired from Central/State Government service, local authority, PSU, or an autonomous corporation are not eligible. Persons convicted in a court of law for an offence involving moral turpitude are not eligible. Canvassing, directly or indirectly, will result in disqualification of candidature. Any dispute regarding this recruitment will be settled within the jurisdiction of the Delhi High Court only. In case the notice is available in a language other than English and a dispute in interpretation arises, the English version will prevail.

content_sections.heading: NCRTC Electrical Engineer Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: NCRTC has announced a total of 17 vacancies across three posts under the Electrical discipline. The vacancy break-up is as follows: The notification does not mention any category-wise (UR/SC/ST/OBC) reservation break-up for these posts.

content_sections.heading: NCRTC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility is assessed as on 23 July 2026 and is common across essential qualification and experience requirements, though the desirable criteria vary slightly by post. All essential qualifications must be from a UGC-recognized Indian University or UGC-recognized Deemed University, or an AICTE-approved course from an autonomous Indian institution or the concerned statutory council, wherever applicable. Candidates claiming equivalence in qualification must produce an equivalence certificate. Essential Experience (all posts): Minimum 20 years of experience working in Central/State Government or Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs). Desirable Experience (all posts): Experience in Haryana Vidyut Nigam or similar organizations shall be an added advantage. 05 years of experience in construction works of EHT (Extra High Tension) lines and cables of 132 KV or higher voltages. Selected candidates across all three posts will plan and monitor the shifting of electrical lines that infringe on the Namo Bharat alignment, covering 66 KV EHT lines and above (including cables), as well as 33 KV/11 KV/415 V underground cables and overhead lines replacing existing electrical infrastructure. The role also involves planning and progressing the shifting of underground cables in place of existing 66 KV and above EHT lines, and the relocation of low-tension overhead lines and streetlight poles that obstruct the Namo Bharat alignment.

content_sections.heading: NCRTC Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit for all three posts is 62 years, calculated as on 23 July 2026. The notification does not mention any age relaxation for reserved categories, as this is a re-employment-based recruitment.

content_sections.heading: NCRTC Electrical Engineer Salary Structure 2026
content_sections.text: NCRTC has specified a consolidated lumpsum remuneration for each post, along with the superannuated pay scale (the pay scale/grade the candidate should have retired from) required for eligibility. In addition to the consolidated remuneration, candidates will receive House Rent Allowance (HRA) and other benefits as per NCRTC's company policy.

rows.superannuated_pay_scale_cda: 3 years of service in Rs. 78800-209200 (L12) or above

content_sections.heading: Term of Contract and Place of Posting
content_sections.text: Term of contract: One (01) year, which may be extended further based on the Corporation's requirement and the individual's performance. Place of posting: Delhi-Bawal and Delhi-Panipat-Karnal Namo Bharat Corridors of NCRTC. Selected candidates may also be assigned other jobs/functions as per business requirements, including shift-based work.

content_sections.heading: NCRTC Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The official vacancy notice does not specify any application fee details for these posts. Candidates are advised to check the official NCRTC website (www.ncrtc.in) or the online application portal for any fee-related updates.

content_sections.heading: NCRTC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria will be shortlisted and called for an interview. The venue, date, and time of the interview will be communicated in advance. Requests for a change in interview date or venue will not be entertained. Document verification will be conducted before the interview. Candidates must carry original certificates for verification; failure to do so will result in the candidate not being allowed to attend the interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for NCRTC Electrical Engineer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: While applying online, candidates need to upload self-attested scanned copies of the following documents: 10th Certificate / Birth Certificate Degree / Diploma Certificate PPO / Superannuation Order Last Salary Slip Experience / Service Certificate / Relieving Order issued by previous organizations Applications submitted without these supporting certificates/documents will be summarily rejected. Candidates should also keep the following ready before starting the online application: A valid e-mail ID and mobile number (must remain active throughout the recruitment process) Scanned self-attested passport-size colour photograph (3.5 cm x 4.5 cm, up to 100 KB, .jpg/.jpeg format only) Scanned copy of signature signed on white paper with blue/black pen (up to 100 KB, .jpg/.jpeg format only)

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NCRTC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The closing date for applying online for NCRTC's Electrical Engineer posts is 24 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NCRTC Recruitment 2026 for Electrical posts?
faq.answer: There are 17 vacancies in total: 4 for Dy. General Manager/Electrical, 5 for Assistant Manager/Electrical, and 8 for Engineering Associate-I/Electrical.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for NCRTC Electrical Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all three posts is 62 years, as on 23 July 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for NCRTC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A B.E./B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering or equivalent is required for the DGM and Assistant Manager posts. For Engineering Associate-I, a B.E./B.Tech. (Electrical) or Diploma (Electrical) or equivalent is required.

faq.question: Q5. Is this recruitment on a permanent basis?
faq.answer: No. This recruitment is on a re-employment basis for a term of one year, which may be extended based on the Corporation's requirement and the candidate's performance.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for NCRTC Electrical Engineer posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated lumpsum remuneration is Rs. 1,09,800 per month for Dy. General Manager/Electrical, Rs. 75,200 per month for Assistant Manager/Electrical, and Rs. 65,800 per month for Engineering Associate-I/Electrical, along with HRA and other benefits as per company policy.
